page.layout: One page of text, centred block, with a running head above it. No marginal notes on this page. Right edge shows a cropped fragment of the facing page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: aliquod gratæ erga V. C. mentis meæ, V. C. dedico, & uestro nomine in lucem prodire cupio: oroq́;, ut me meosq; omnes V. C. commendatos habeant. Æternus Pater Domini nostri IESV Christi, unà cum Filio & Spiritu suo sancto, totâ familiam Marchionum Brandeburgensium diu incolumem ac saluam conseruet: & uos etiâ illustrissimos Principes sic gubernet, ut uestra gubernatio ad gloriam nominis sui celebrandam, ac subditorum salutem dirigatur: Amen. Bene & feliciter V. C. ualeant. Datæ Basileæ, 12. Calend. Decembr. anno 1562.

page.notes: The "IESV" in the text is set in small capitals; copied as IESV. The signature lines are set in a heavier italic/black-letter-like face; transcribed as italic. The running head is printed as EPISTOLA with the letters spaced. No page number is printed.
